**Professional Experience**  
*Senior Product Manager*  
NovaGame Studios (2020–Present)  
Led cross-functional teams to deliver three AAA titles, including *ChronoQuest 2*, which achieved 1.2M active users in its first quarter. Spearheaded data-driven decisions that increased retention by 25% through integration of SQL analytics and behavioral segmentation. Orchestrated roadmap planning aligned with quarterly business goals, reducing time-to-market for key features by 18%. Managed stakeholder expectations across engineering, design, and marketing, ensuring alignment on product vision.  

*Junior Product Manager*  
Eclipse Games (2018–2020)  
Collaborated with developers to refine *Galaxy Clash*’s core mechanics, resulting in a 30% improvement in user engagement. Conducted competitive analysis of five rivals, identifying underserved niches that informed a monetization strategy boosting in-app purchases by 22%. Facilitated UX research sessions with 50+ players, translating insights into UI/UX refinements that reduced drop-off rates by 15%.  

*Product Analyst*  
PixelPulse Interactive (2016–2018)  
Built dashboards using Power BI to track user behavior across 10+ games, enabling data-informed decisions that improved conversion rates by 12%. Partnered with designers to optimize onboarding flows, contributing to a 20% increase in daily active users.  

**Professional Summary**  
A seasoned product manager with a decade of experience shaping gaming experiences that resonate with global audiences. Specialized in aligning technical feasibility with business objectives, delivering scalable solutions that balance innovation and user-centric design. Mentorship and architectural guidance have defined long-term success across multiple product cycles.

*Galaxy Clash Monetization Overhaul* (Eclipse Games, 2019)  
Redesigned in-app purchase model based on player spending patterns, increasing average revenue per user by 22% without compromising core gameplay.
